name: pinned-rust-toolchain
goal: Ordinary Rust entry points use the toolchain pinned in rust-toolchain.toml through rustup, whatever cargo is first on PATH; without rustup or the pin they fail and say so.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: First cargo on PATH is a standalone 1.72 without fmt; no rustup shims. check:kernel exit 101, no such command fmt. Spec: specification/features/planned/pinned-rust-toolchain.md.

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test; record the defect assertion and command.
steps.evidence: Unmodified PATH: bun run check:kernel exit 101, /tmp/harness-pinned-rust-red.log and root's /tmp/harness-default-toolchain-red.log. Selection tests: 5 failed on the placeholder.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: pinnedToolchain asks rustup which and puts the toolchain bin first on PATH. scripts/rust.ts runs it; check:kernel, build-kernel and both tool commands use it. No version named.

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unmodified PATH: check:kernel exit 0, build:kernel exit 0 with rustc 1.99.0 in build.json, tools report 1.99.0, parity and boundary 9 passed, selection tests 5 passed unchanged.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots; keep pending until proof passes.
